extraction.input_text: On the issue of whether Albert supported environmental reform, the fact that his car has many stickers with environmental slogans.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The evidence consists of physical stickers on a car, which constitutes circumstantial evidence rather than an out-of-court statement.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as an out-of-court statement; circumstantial evidence falls outside this definition.
arguments.evidence_span: the fact that his car has many stickers with environmental slogans.

arguments.text: There is no identifiable declarant who made an assertion regarding environmental reform.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(1) requires a declarant's assertion for evidence to qualify as hearsay.
arguments.evidence_span: the fact that his car has many stickers with environmental slogans.

arguments.text: Although the evidence is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted (Albert's support), this purpose alone does not trigger hearsay without an underlying assertion.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(2) requires the statement to be offered for the truth, but the threshold requirement of a statement is unmet.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Albert supported environmental reform
